mail.title: Mail
mail.descriptionEmpty: Connect the company mailbox and messages land here, linked to their client.
mail.syncedCount: {count, plural, one {# new message} other {# new messages}}
mail.threadCount: {count, plural, =0 {No conversations} one {# conversation} other {# conversations}}
mail.pickThread: Pick a conversation to read it.

connect.title: Connect the mailbox
connect.description: Defaults are set for IONOS. The password is the mailbox one: find it (or change it) in the IONOS panel, under Mail → the mailbox → server settings.
connect.usernameHint: On IONOS it is the address itself.
connect.passwordHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
connect.privacy: The password is encrypted with the server key and only opened to connect to the mailbox. It is never logged or sent to the browser.

errors.credentials: The mailbox rejected those details: check the username and password.
errors.connect: The mailbox could not be saved.
errors.sync: Mail could not be fetched. See the notice on the page.
errors.send: The message could not be sent.
errors.generic: The operation could not be completed.
errors.badAddress: An address does not look like an email (or there are too many).
errors.notConfigured: Reading mail works, but sending does not: the server is missing the Brevo key (BREVO_API_KEY) and its SMTP port is closed. Once the key is added, sending works with nothing else to change.

chat.title: Mail

chat.empty: No mail with this file yet. Write the first one below.
chat.subject: Subject of the new mail
chat.shortcut: ⌘ + Enter to send. It arrives as a normal email, with its subject.
chat.noRecipient: Say who you are sending it to.
chat.subjectRequired: A new topic needs a subject.
chat.sendUnavailable: Reading mail works, but sending does not: the server is missing the Brevo key (BREVO_API_KEY) and its SMTP port is closed. Once the key is added, sending works with nothing else to change.
